Hi Robbie,

I came across The Process, your therapy thriller set at a retreat on the North Devon coast, and the way it blends a gripping story with practical psychological ideas from your years as an NLP trainer caught my attention.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Since The Process is already out in audiobook, I noticed the story and your coaching background lend themselves well to short visual content. If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for The Process is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. This would be an optional add-on to the feature, never a requirement.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you like to hear more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Process best?

Warm regards,
